regions.label: <rug 1>
regions.prompt: Large rectangular area rug with a weathered, distressed texture in shades of cool grey, charcoal, and beige. The pattern is abstract and mottled, with darker patches concentrated on the image-left and center. It sits on a light-toned wood floor.

regions.label: <table 1>
regions.prompt: Rectangular coffee table with a thick, dark gray concrete-textured top supported by a thin black metal frame base. The base is an open rectangular prism design with slender legs and a perimeter floor rail. On the table surface sit a dark matte bowl, a small light gray ceramic vase, and a stack of two books. The table is centered over a textured, mottled gray area rug.

regions.label: <bowl 1>
regions.prompt: A dark charcoal-grey, matte-finished ceramic bowl with a wide, rounded body and a slightly tapered base. The interior is a deep black, and the thin rim has a subtle, light-grey edge. It sits on a dark, textured grey surface.

regions.label: <vase 1>
regions.prompt: Small, rounded ceramic vase with a matte, textured light-grey surface. It has a squat, bulbous body that tapers slightly towards a narrow neck at the top. The base is flat and sits on a dark, stone-like surface. Green leafy stems emerge from the top opening.

regions.label: <plant 1>
regions.prompt: Small, bushy green plant with numerous thin, branching stems and tiny, rounded leaves. The foliage is dense and clustered, with several stems extending outward and upward, creating an irregular, textured silhouette.

regions.label: <book 1>
regions.prompt: A thick, light-grey hardcover book lies flat on a dark surface. The front cover features a large, dark, rectangular graphic or photograph centered on its upper half. The book's spine is visible on the image-left, and its thick, light-colored pages are visible along the front edge. It rests atop another similar, slightly thinner book.

regions.label: <sofa 1>
regions.prompt: Large L-shaped sectional sofa upholstered in light-gray textured fabric. The left section is a chaise longue with a single long cushion, while the right section features two seat cushions and matching backrest cushions. Three square throw pillows in varying shades of gray are arranged in the corner. A dark charcoal-gray knit throw blanket is draped over the right armrest and seat. The sofa has a low-profile design with short, dark block feet.

regions.label: <pillow 1>
regions.prompt: A rectangular throw pillow with a light gray, textured fabric cover. The surface has a subtle, heathered appearance with fine horizontal and vertical weave patterns. It is positioned upright, leaning slightly against a sofa backrest, with soft shadows defining its plump, rounded edges.

regions.label: <pillow 2>
regions.prompt: A square, plump throw pillow with a medium-gray, finely textured fabric. It is positioned upright and angled slightly toward the image-left, partially overlapping another gray pillow behind it. The pillow has soft, rounded corners and a uniform, matte finish.

regions.label: <pillow 3>
regions.prompt: A square, light-gray throw pillow with a soft, matte fabric texture. It is angled slightly toward the image-left, resting against a larger, darker gray sofa cushion. The pillow has a plump, well-filled appearance with soft, rounded corners and edges. Light from the image-left creates a gentle gradient across its surface, with the image-left side appearing brighter than the shadowed image-right side.

regions.label: <pillow 4>
regions.prompt: A medium-gray throw pillow with a textured, woven fabric finish. It has a soft, rectangular shape with rounded corners and a slight indentation at the top center. The pillow is angled towards the image-left, partially overlapping another identical gray pillow behind it. A dark, textured charcoal-colored blanket or throw is visible at the bottom edge.

regions.label: <blanket 1>
regions.prompt: A dark charcoal-grey, textured knit blanket draped over the arm of a light grey sofa. The fabric has a chunky, nubby weave and hangs in heavy, vertical folds. One portion of the blanket rests on the sofa seat at the image-left, while the main section cascades down the front of the sofa arm, nearly reaching the floor. The bottom edge of the blanket features a short, frayed fringe.

regions.label: <lamp 1>
regions.prompt: A floor lamp with a wide, cylindrical drum shade made of light beige textured fabric. A thin, dark brown or black metal pole extends vertically from the bottom of the crop, connecting to the center of the shade's underside. The shade is illuminated from within, casting a warm, soft glow against the plain off-white wall.

regions.label: <painting 1>
regions.prompt: Large vertical rectangular painting in a thin black frame, viewed from a slight angle. The abstract composition features a textured, light beige or off-white upper field that occupies the top three-quarters of the canvas. The bottom quarter consists of a dark charcoal or black horizontal band with a rough, uneven upper edge that suggests a silhouetted landscape or horizon line. The entire surface has a matte, slightly grainy texture.

regions.label: <television 1>
regions.prompt: Large flat-screen television with a thin black bezel and a matte black screen, mounted on a white wall. The screen is shown from a slight side angle, revealing its slim profile and dark gray side edge. A small, subtle logo is centered on the bottom bezel.

regions.label: <cabinet 1>
regions.prompt: Long, low-profile media cabinet made of light-toned wood with a visible horizontal grain. The unit features four handleless, flat-panel doors across its front. A black rectangular soundbar sits on the top surface towards the image-left. The cabinet rests on a light wood floor, with its left side and front faces visible from a three-quarter perspective.

regions.label: <soundbar 1>
regions.prompt: Long, rectangular matte black soundbar with a mesh-textured front and top. It sits horizontally on a light wood-grained surface, angled slightly toward the image-right. The front face is slightly recessed within a thin black frame.

regions.label: <vase 2>
regions.prompt: Small, dark charcoal-gray ceramic vase with a matte, textured surface. It has a rounded, bulbous body that tapers slightly towards a narrow neck and a flat base. The lighting creates a soft highlight on the upper right side of its curved form.

regions.label: <plant 2>
regions.prompt: A cluster of thin, dark-brown stems branching upwards and outwards, densely covered with small, oval-shaped green leaves. The foliage forms a bushy, rounded arrangement against a plain white wall.

regions.label: <frame 1>
regions.prompt: Right edge of a thin black picture frame on a white wall. Inside the frame, a wide off-white mat surrounds a vertical grayscale artwork featuring a dark, textured, and slightly mottled abstract pattern.

regions.label: <window 1>
regions.prompt: Large tripartite window with a black frame and two vertical mullions. Through the glass, a lush outdoor scene features a tall deciduous tree with a thick trunk and dense green leaves on the image-left. In the background, a light-colored house with a dark gabled roof is partially visible behind thick green shrubbery and trees. The bottom edge of the window frame sits just above a light-colored interior surface.

regions.label: <tree 2>
regions.prompt: A tall deciduous tree with a thick, textured grey-brown trunk stands on the image-left, its canopy of dense, light-green leaves filling the upper and central portions of the frame. The tree is viewed through a large window, with two vertical black metal mullions dividing the scene into three panes. In the background, a two-story house with a grey gabled roof and white siding is partially visible through the lush green foliage of other surrounding trees and shrubs.

regions.label: <tree 3>
regions.prompt: A tall deciduous tree with a thick, textured grey-brown trunk situated on the image-left, visible through a large window. Its canopy of dense, light-green leaves fills much of the upper and middle sections of the frame. In the background, a light-colored house with a dark gabled roof is partially obscured by the foliage. Two vertical black window mullions divide the view into three panes.

regions.label: <house 1>
regions.prompt: A two-story residential house with a dark gray shingled roof and light gray siding is partially visible through dense green foliage. A vertical black window frame bisects the center of the crop. To the image-left of the frame, a portion of the house's lower level and roofline is visible behind trees. To the image-right, the house features a prominent gabled roof and a white-trimmed window on the upper floor, largely obscured by the bright green leaves of a foreground tree.

regions.label: <walls 1>
regions.prompt: Off-white, smooth-textured walls enclose the room. On the image-left, a flat wall features a large, wall-mounted black television and a small, vertically-oriented black-framed picture further left. The center wall contains a large, black-framed three-pane window looking out onto green trees and a house. To the image-right of the window, the wall is partially obscured by a floor lamp with a cylindrical cream shade and a large, square abstract painting with a black lower half and a light grey upper half. The walls meet a flat white ceiling with two small, recessed circular lights. A thin white baseboard runs along the bottom of the walls where they meet the light-colored wood flooring.

regions.label: <ceiling 1>
regions.prompt: Flat, smooth off-white ceiling featuring two small, circular recessed downlights spaced apart. The surface is evenly lit with soft, subtle gradients, meeting the vertical walls at clean, straight edges on the image-left and image-right.

regions.label: <floor 1>
regions.prompt: Light-colored hardwood floor with wide planks running from the bottom-left toward the top-right. A large, rectangular area rug with a weathered, mottled grey and charcoal texture sits atop the wood, centered under a dark grey stone coffee table with a thin black metal frame. To the image-left, the base of a light oak wood media console rests on the floor. To the image-right, the lower portion of a grey fabric sectional sofa and a dark grey knit throw blanket draped over its arm sit on the rug.

layout.prompt:
This is a photo of a modern, minimalist living room. The aesthetic is clean and contemporary, with a neutral color palette of white, gray, and light wood tones. The mood is calm and airy, illuminated by soft natural light coming from a large window.

In the foreground, a large, rectangular <rug 1> with a mottled gray and white pattern covers much of the light-colored wood floor. Centered on <rug 1> is a low, rectangular <table 1> with a dark gray, textured top and a thin black metal frame. On <table 1> sit several decorative items: a small, dark gray <bowl 1>, a small, light gray <vase 1> containing a leafy green <plant 1>, and a small stack of <book 1>.

To the right of <table 1>, a large, L-shaped <sofa 1> upholstered in a light gray fabric dominates the middle ground. It is adorned with several matching gray throw <pillow 1>, <pillow 2>, <pillow 3>, and <pillow 4>. A dark gray, knitted <blanket 1> is draped over the right armrest of <sofa 1>. Behind the right section of <sofa 1>, a tall <lamp 1> with a thin black stand and a large, cylindrical white fabric shade stands in the corner. To the right of <lamp 1>, a large, vertical, rectangular <painting 1> hangs on the white wall. <Painting 1> features a minimalist, abstract design with a dark, textured lower half and a lighter, off-white upper half.

On the image-left side of the room, a large, flat-screen <television 1> is mounted on a white wall. Below <television 1>, a long, low, light-wood <cabinet 1> runs along the wall. A black <soundbar 1> sits on the left side of <cabinet 1>. To the right of <soundbar 1> on <cabinet 1> is a small, dark gray <vase 2> with a leafy green <plant 2>. To the left of <television 1>, a small portion of a black <frame 1> is visible on the wall.

In the background, a large, black-framed <window 1> with three vertical panes is centered on the wall. Through <window 1>, a lush green <tree 2> and <tree 3> are visible, along with a glimpse of a neighboring <house 1> with a gray roof. The walls are a clean, matte white, and the ceiling is flat with a few recessed light fixtures. The overall composition is balanced and symmetrical, emphasizing the room's open and spacious feel.
